faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Find answers to the most common questions about our services.

questions.question: What is the difference between VPS and Dedicated Servers?
questions.answer: A VPS (Virtual Private Server) is a virtualized server that shares physical hardware with other VPSs, but has dedicated resources allocated to it. A Dedicated Server is an entire physical machine dedicated solely to your use, offering maximum performance and control.

questions.question: How secure are your Private RDP solutions?
questions.answer: Our Private RDP solutions implement multiple security measures including enterprise-grade encryption, network isolation, custom firewall rules, and regular security updates. We also offer two-factor authentication and IP restrictions for additional security.

questions.question: Do you offer managed services?
questions.answer: Yes, we provide managed services for all our hosting solutions. Our team can handle system updates, security patches, monitoring, backups, and troubleshooting, allowing you to focus on your business instead of server management.

questions.question: What is your uptime guarantee?
questions.answer: We guarantee 99.9% uptime for all our services. In the rare event that we don't meet this guarantee, you'll receive credits according to our Service Level Agreement (SLA).

questions.question: Can I upgrade my plan as my needs grow?
questions.answer: Absolutely! All our plans are designed to scale with your business. You can easily upgrade your resources through our client portal without any service interruption or data loss.
